changeinfo.changes:
The following features are added:
  • The game always saves, so Trophy 'Grinder Man' can be unlocked

The following features are added:
  • Trophies will now unlock, if the network is disconnected

The following features are added:
  • Ages 6-11 are now allowed to view and post to the leaderboards
  • Booting the game without a Facebook® account bound, no longer produces an error dialog
  • Canceling the Facebook® authorization dialog no longer produces an error
  • Changing your password on the Facebook® web site will now prompt you for a new password in-game
